# Elsewhere

> Live radio from someone else's now. Pick a city on the globe, land there, listen to a real local station, and stay long enough to be stamped in your passport. Free, no account, no streaks or scores.

Elsewhere streams real stations from the open Radio Browser catalogue. It shows the local hour, language and a few notes about the place. Anything not said by the station comes from the Keeper's notebook and is labelled as such. The Keeper never invents a song title.

## Pages
- [Home](https://elsewheremusic.com/): the departures board and globe of live stations.
- [How it works](https://elsewheremusic.com/about): land, listen, get stamped, send a ticket, ask the Keeper.
- [Terms, privacy, credits](https://elsewheremusic.com/legal): terms, what is and is not collected, station and data credits.
